name: Selective Ability (Pact)
body:
You can exclude creatures from the effects of your occult powers.

Prerequisite(s): Bind spirit class feature, ability to bind 4th-level spirits.

Benefit: Whenever you activate a granted ability that affects an area, you may exclude a number of creatures from the granted ability’s effects equal to your Charisma modifier.

These targets are not affected by your granted ability.
